rules.name: Prevent Breaking HTML Structure
rules.instruction: The main application is a single standalone HTML file. Do not split it or add build steps unless explicitly creating a backend API. Keep all CSS and JavaScript embedded.

rules.name: Keep localStorage Key Versioned
rules.instruction: Always use versioned keys for localStorage (e.g., 'tlStudio.versions.v1'). When changing storage format, increment the version number to prevent conflicts with old data.

rules.name: XSS Prevention
rules.instruction: Use escapeHtml() for user-facing text and escapeAttr() for HTML attributes. Never use innerHTML with unsanitized user input. Existing code has these helpers; maintain them.

rules.name: Mutation Pattern
rules.instruction: Follow the established mutation pattern: pushHistory() → mutate state → saveFlash() → render(). Every user action that changes data must call these in order.

rules.name: No Error Suppression
rules.instruction: Only add try/catch at storage boundaries (localStorage.getItem). Trust internal code and framework guarantees. Do not add error handling for scenarios that can't happen.

rules.name: CSS Variables for Theming
rules.instruction: Use CSS variables defined in :root for all colors, fonts, and spacing. Do not hardcode colors in CSS classes. This enables future dark mode and custom theme support.

rules.name: Version Export Schema
rules.instruction: Version objects must always contain: { id, name, group, savedAt, data: { swimlanes, projectTitle } }. This schema is backward-compatible for future API migrations.

rules.name: No Backend Required (Unless Planned)
rules.instruction: Current version is standalone with no server dependency. Any backend features (auth, database, real-time sync) must be clearly marked as Phase 1+. Keep the HTML file functional without a backend.
